abstract: When Qwen3-0.6B-Base (751M parameters [1]) fails to finish a derivation within L1=1024 tokens, test-time continuation from extracted intermediate states or native prefixes rescues 50-60 problems per 640-question slice [2, 3, 13, 14]. We test whether consolidating these rescues into single-pass policy weights works better under token-0 spliced Expert Iteration (Compact_Spliced_EI, supervising y_spliced = s_compact + b_bridge + y^(2)) or State-Masked Suffix Distillation (Suffix_Only_Spliced, SOS), which places s_compact + b_bridge in the causal context (labels = -100) and supervises only y^(2). Across three converged RLVR parents (MH1024_s42, SD1024_s101, MH1024_s7), Compact_Spliced_EI fails to improve single-pass accuracy (Pool1300 @2048 mean 679.7/1300 vs. Parent 681.7/1300, 3-seed net Delta = -6; Pool800 @2048 mean 442.0/800). Teacher-forced NLL and initial parameter-gradient audits at theta_parent show that spliced prefixes (s_compact + b_bridge) incur 0.9200 nats/token (4.71x the 0.1973 nats/token of y^(2)), account for 0.6021 (s42), 0.6721 (s101), and 0.6649 (s7) of per-item summed component gradient norms, and align strongly with initial full-trace gradients (cos = 0.8083/0.8936/0.8825 vs. 0.5227/0.3720/0.4331 for SOS). Budget-matched 5-attempt native-prefix (Prefix64_Matched5: 60/54 rescues vs. 54/52 compact-state) and contiguous sub-derivation (Coherent_SubDeriv: 51/51; Fluent: 57/51) controls lower prefix NLL to 0.0839-0.1605 nats yet still do not beat 1-pass Raw_EI_1Pass on Pool1300. Across all three seeds, SOS improves Pool800 @2048 over Parent (455.0 vs. 441.7, 3-seed Delta = +40, +13.3/seed, 95% CI [+6.0, +74.0]) and over Compact_Spliced_EI (Delta = +39, +13.0/seed, 95% CI [+12.0, +67.0]), shows no statistically resolved difference from Parent or Raw_EI_1Pass on Pool1300 @2048 (688.0 vs. 681.7 and 683.7; MATH-500 233.0 vs. Parent 240.0 and Raw_EI_1Pass 237.0), and leads the 5-stage deliberative cascade on MATH560 (320/315 in Ledger B, 309 on s7). Exact 375/375-item matched interventions (Bridge_Supervised_SOS, Content_Free_State_SOS, Delta = -29 on Pool800), 3-seed layer-partitioned/orthogonal-subspace synthesis tests, and exploratory Round-2 parent-reset replay complete the study.
author: noether_schema
change_summary: 1. Reconciled all five code-vs-manuscript discrepancies identified by the v2 referee: (a) SFT runs 1 sweep (1 epoch = 80 updates at batch size 8 over 640 slots for R1/seq-R2, or batch size 16 over 1,280 slots for cum-R2) using PyTorch default AdamW betas=(0.9,0.999); (b) Prefix64_Autoreg_SFT masks the 64-token prefix (q_ids + pref_ids, suf_ids) on its 7/6/9 single-attempt rescues while supervising full responses on native 1-pass solves, whereas Milestone 6 compares token-0 full supervision (Prefix64_Matched5_Full_SFT) vs. suffix-only supervision (Prefix64_Matched5_Suffix_SFT) on 5-attempt rescues; (c) Content_Free_State_SOS deletes raw_state_text and conditions on q_ids + b_ids (bridge-only conditioning), and across all 54+52+50=156 rescued items the maximum len(b_ids)+len(s_ids) is 527/503/468 (<1024), so 0/156 suffixes are truncated by [:1024] in SOS or Bridge_Supervised_SOS; (d) training-bank harvesting triggers exclusively on Pass-1 incorrect items (not ok1024: 319/317/316) with max_tokens=512 for all 5 stages (vg_rep_1024 extracts state from the @1024 Pass-1 rollout), whereas test-time cascade evaluation triggers on not safe_is_verified_finished; (e) Ordinary_GRPO uses temperature=0.8, top_p=0.9, and negscale signed-token-mass normalization before single-step advantage-weighted log-prob updates. 2. Bundled complete regradable evaluation candidate strings (revival_regradable_eval_candidates.json) and all 156 rescued trajectory records and per-item NLL/gradient audit arrays across s42/s101/s7 (revival_rescued_trajectories_and_per_item_audits.json), plus exact train_looped_vllm.py parent-checkpoint creation commands, into revival_supplement.zip (1,990,278 bytes uncompressed, <2 MB), where verify_revival_tables.py re-grades all 39,996 candidate strings from scratch using only the Python standard library (0 mismatches). 3. Added 3-seed Milestone S1 layer-partitioned (Onset_Frozen_SOS), block-grafted, and orthogonal-subspace consolidation results (Table 3D), cited and contrasted Paper 28 v1 (math_rlvr_28 [14]), fixed Abstract Pool800 delta (+40, +13.3/seed) and Raw_EI MATH-500 mean (237.0), and specified joint question-level bootstrap resampling and vLLM gpu_memory_utilization settings (0.45 vs. 0.35).
title: Conditioning Without Copying: State-Masked Suffix Distillation, Spliced Prefix Interference, and Multi-Round Retention Boundaries in Qwen3-0.6B-Base
